query:
select 'youbike_dates' as item,to_jsonb(t) as evidence from (select date,records,stations from public.mv_youbike_h3_dates order by date desc limit 1)t
union all select 'youbike_live',to_jsonb(t) from (select day,count(*) as payloads,max(refreshed_at) as latest_refresh from live.youbike_h3_daily where day=current_date group by day limit 1)t
union all select 'flight_summary',to_jsonb(t) from (select day,records,flights from live.flight_trails_days_summary where day='2026-09-26' limit 1)t
union all select 'flight_raw',to_jsonb(t) from (select count(*) as rows,count(distinct flight_id) as flights from live.flight_trails_daily where day='2026-09-26' limit 1)t
union all select 'waste_raw',to_jsonb(t) from (select day,city,count(*) as trails from live.waste_trails_daily where day=current_date group by day,city limit 10)t
union all select 'waste_matched',to_jsonb(t) from (select day,city,count(*) as segments from live.waste_trails_matched_daily where day=current_date group by day,city limit 10)t
union all select 'h3_latest_year',to_jsonb(t) from (select year,resolution,count(*) as cells from spatial.h3_demographics_yearly where year=113 and resolution in (7,8) group by year,resolution limit 2)t limit 30
